Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 26

“Others offer hearing and the other senses into the fires of restraint; still others offer sound and the other objects into the fires of the senses.”

A striking symmetry — one group feeds the senses to discipline, another feeds experience to the senses. Krishna is showing that engagement can be an offering too.
